Area.evidence_source: Men's high rates of suicide are frequently linked to health service issues. In contradictory public discussions, suicidal men are presented sometimes as victims of "poor" health services and sometimes as irremediable, "poor" help seekers (e.g., Macdonald, 2011; Möller-Leimkühler, 2003).
